deployment: Local browser, FastAPI and PostgreSQL. Approved model inference is external, not offline.
pipeline: owner-serialized lease and bounded relevant context

contents: raw and formatted text as one observation
sources.retry: Same identity and content is idempotent. Changed content under that identity rejects the import batch.

contents: terminal outcome or fixed failure category
jobs.learning: Saving a source is not successful extraction.

passages_and_claim_evidence.limit: Valid references do not establish semantic entailment.

lifecycle_and_receipts.schema_names: See the authoritative ORM and migrations; this is a logical grouping.

model_calls_and_budget.credentials: Environment only; never returned by UI or committed.
model_calls_and_budget.billing: Actual provider bill is not measured.

retrieval.implemented: PostgreSQL lexical candidates plus permitted structured-memory context and source provenance
retrieval.publication: Recheck revocation and source permissions before releasing an answer.

normal_inference.unfamiliar: Unfamiliar Normal input requires operator opt-in plus the NVIDIA data-policy acknowledgement and a configured key.
normal_inference.warning: Selected text leaves the machine for NVIDIA inference and trial retention/training terms may apply.

controls.forget: Block future use/relearning from excluded support and known duplicates; retained originals are not physically erased

evaluation.interpretation: Mechanical screens are not semantic certification. Failed and unassessed cases must remain in denominators.

security.local_service: Loopback-only prototype, not multi-user production authentication
